collected_by.note: reads files of the exported tree only; nothing imported, installed, downloaded or executed; requirement-file selection and line rules follow the BOMBridge gap-discovery overlay

limitations: source declarations state what the requirement files name; they do not show what is built, installed or loaded
requirement files are matched by name; a file installed under another name is not found
markers are preserved as text and never evaluated; -r/-c directives are reported, not followed
only Python requirement files are read; other declaration files are listed by name and never compared

model_references are statically observed HTTP(S) model-file URLs in Python string constants, Dockerfile lines and shell lines (UIP-13): not download, load, execution or selection, possibly dead code, a docstring or a string that is not a setting; dynamic expressions are diagnostics only; crypto_call_sites are statically observed Python hashlib calls (UIP-12): not execution, not proof that the called module is the standard library, and not a statement about cryptography the scan did not observe

model_sources.timing: the budget is soft: checked between bounded operations only; an in-flight read or ast.parse can overrun it

searched.order: depth-first; per directory, files then subdirectories, each in byte-wise name order; symlinks not followed

python.timing: the budget is soft: checked between bounded operations only; an in-flight parse/visit/audit can overrun it
